decision.title: Batching Book lookups
decision.question: GET /books accepts ids (comma-separated), so Book lookups can be batched. If Book becomes an entity, should the subgraph use a $batch connector over GET /books?ids= or one GET /books/{bookId} per key?
decision.context: Recommendation: batch, if Book is an entity: OrderItem.book and cross-subgraph references then cost one request per page, not per item. batch find reports nothing yet because no type is keyed; this only applies once the entities decision makes Book one. GET /books is paged (max 50), so a batch above 50 ids needs checking.

choices.label: $batch via GET /books?ids= (one request for many books)
